author: ABMN Staff
title: Research Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for November, 26th (AAPL, CBRL, CSFL, ENDP, IDXG, KMI, MAC, MRK, NFLX, SCGLY)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Nov 26th, 2018 // No Comments
Research Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Monday, November 26th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its target price trimmed by Loop Capital to $225.00. Loop Capital currently has a buy rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Cracker Barrel Old Country Store (NASDAQ:CBRL) had its price target raised by Wells Fargo & Co from $139.00 to $157.00. The firm currently has a market perform rating on the stock.
Centerstate Bank (NASDAQ:CSFL) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Stephens. Stephens currently has a $30.00 price target on the stock.
Endo International (NASDAQ:ENDP) (TSE:ENL) had its price target lowered by Mizuho to $15.00. They currently have a neutral rating on the stock.
Interpace Diagnostics Group (NASDAQ:IDXG) was given a $4.00 price target by analysts at Maxim Group. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Kinder Morgan (NYSE:KMI) had its underperform rating reiterated by analysts at Wolfe Research.
Macerich (NYSE:MAC) had its target price reduced by BTIG Research to $63.00. They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
Merck KGaA (FRA:MRK) had its neutral rating reaffirmed by analysts at DZ Bank AG.
Netflix (NASDAQ:NFLX) was given a $315.00 target price by analysts at Macquarie. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Societe Generale (OTCMKTS:SCGLY) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Jefferies Financial Group Inc.
Splunk (NASDAQ:SPLK) had its target price reduced by Piper Jaffray Companies to $120.00. The firm currently has an overweight rating on the stock.
United Technologies (NYSE:UTX) was given a $147.00 target price by analysts at Wolfe Research. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Standpoint Research initiated coverage on shares of Zillow Group (NASDAQ:Z) . Standpoint Research issued a buy rating and a $48.00 target price on the stock.
